description:
You are working as an IT Helpdesk operator. Several users have reported that legitimate mailing list emails are landing in their Junk folder due to a recent spam filter update. 

Your task is to:
1. Open the Junk folder and identify the legitimate emails (false positives) mixed in with the real spam.
2. Create a new folder named 'False-Positives' (exact name).
3. Move ONLY the legitimate emails from Junk into this new 'False-Positives' folder. Leave the actual spam in Junk.
4. Draft an email to 'helpdesk-admin@techcorp.org' with the subject 'Spam Filter Incident Report'. In the body, report how many legitimate emails you found and rescued.

Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
